title: ENISA on Air
author: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity
description: About ENISA on Air ENISA, the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity, wanted to provide its audiences with a new channel to hear updates from the Agency but importantly to create a space where we will have the opportunity to explore the issues shaping Europe’s cybersecurity landscape. Our goal is simple: to decrypt the latest cybersecurity developments and bring these conversations closer to you — clearly, directly and within the context that matters.

episodes_recents.titre: ENISA On Air Episode 1: Cybersecurity in the Era of Frontier AI
